verses.original: בִּשְׁנַת֙ שְׁבַֽע־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְפֶ֖קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֑הוּ מָלַ֛ךְ אָחָ֥ז בֶּן־ יוֹתָ֖ם מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ šə·ḇa‘- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh lə·p̄e·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū mā·laḵ ’ā·ḥāz ben- yō·w·ṯām me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: In the seventeenth . . . . . . year of Pekah son of Remaliah Ahaz son of Jotham became king . . . of Judah

verses.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ אָחָ֣ז בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְלֹא־ עָשָׂ֣ה הַיָּשָׁ֗ר בְּעֵינֵ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֖יו כְּדָוִ֥ד אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh ’ā·ḥāz bə·mā·lə·ḵōw wə·šêš- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·lō- ‘ā·śāh hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw kə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: Ahaz was twenty years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen . . . years And unlike David his father he did not do what was right in the eyes of the LORD his God

verses.original: וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּדֶ֖רֶךְ מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְגַ֤ם אֶת־ בְּנוֹ֙ הֶעֱבִ֣יר בָּאֵ֔שׁ כְּתֹֽעֲבוֹת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹרִ֤ישׁ יְהוָה֙ אֹתָ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ bə·ḏe·reḵ mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl wə·ḡam ’eṯ- bə·nōw he·‘ĕ·ḇîr bā·’êš kə·ṯō·‘ă·ḇō·wṯ hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer hō·w·rîš Yah·weh ’ō·ṯām mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Instead, he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel and even sacrificed his son in the fire according to the abominations of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites . . .

verses.original: וַיְזַבֵּ֧חַ וַיְקַטֵּ֛ר בַּבָּמ֖וֹת וְעַל־ הַגְּבָע֑וֹת וְתַ֖חַת כָּל־ עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·zab·bê·aḥ way·qaṭ·ṭêr bab·bā·mō·wṯ wə·‘al- hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ kāl- ‘êṣ ra·‘ă·nān
verses.literal: And he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places on the hills and under every green tree

verses.original: אָ֣ז יַעֲלֶ֣ה רְצִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲ֠רָם וּפֶ֨קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֧הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַיָּצֻ֙רוּ֙ עַל־ אָחָ֔ז וְלֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ לְהִלָּחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz ya·‘ă·leh rə·ṣîn me·leḵ- ’ă·rām ū·p̄e·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl yə·rū·šā·lim lam·mil·ḥā·māh way·yā·ṣu·rū ‘al- ’ā·ḥāz wə·lō yā·ḵə·lū lə·hil·lā·ḥêm
verses.literal: Then Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to wage war against Jerusalem They besieged . . . Ahaz but could not overcome him

verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא הֵ֠שִׁיב רְצִ֨ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֤ם אֶת־ אֵילַת֙ לַֽאֲרָ֔ם וַיְנַשֵּׁ֥ל אֶת־ הַיְהוּדִ֖ים מֵֽאֵיל֑וֹת וַאֲרַמִּים בָּ֣אוּ אֵילַ֔ת וַיֵּ֣שְׁבוּ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: bā·‘êṯ ha·hî hê·šîḇ rə·ṣîn me·leḵ- ’ă·rām ’eṯ- ’ê·laṯ la·’ă·rām way·naš·šêl ’eṯ- hay·hū·ḏîm mê·’ê·lō·wṯ wa·ʾă·ram·mīm bā·’ū ’ê·laṯ way·yê·šə·ḇū šām ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: At that time Rezin king of Aram recovered Elath for Aram drove out the men of Judah and sent the Edomites into Elath where they live to this day

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח אָחָ֜ז מַלְאָכִ֗ים אֶל־ תִּ֠גְלַת פְּלֶ֤סֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁוּר֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר עַבְדְּךָ֥ וּבִנְךָ֖ אָ֑נִי עֲלֵ֨ה וְהוֹשִׁעֵ֜נִי מִכַּ֣ף מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֗ם וּמִכַּף֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַקּוֹמִ֖ים עָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’ā·ḥāz mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- tiḡ·laṯ pə·le·ser me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr lê·mōr ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ū·ḇin·ḵā ’ā·nî ‘ă·lêh wə·hō·wō·ši·‘ê·nî mik·kap̄ me·leḵ- ’ă·rām ū·mik·kap̄ me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl haq·qō·w·mîm ‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria saying I am your servant and your son Come up and save me from the hands of the kings of Aram . . . and Israel who are rising up against me

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אָחָ֜ז אֶת־ הַכֶּ֣סֶף וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָ֗ב הַנִּמְצָא֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וּבְאֹֽצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח לְמֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֖וּר שֹֽׁחַד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’ā·ḥāz ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ wə·’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ han·nim·ṣā bêṯ Yah·weh ū·ḇə·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ bêṯ ham·me·leḵ way·yiš·laḥ lə·me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr šō·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: Ahaz also took the silver and gold found in the house of the LORD and in the treasuries of the king’s palace and he sent it as a gift to the king of Assyria

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע אֵלָיו֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַיַּעַל֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ אַשּׁ֤וּר אֶל־ דַּמֶּ֙שֶׂק֙ וַֽיִּתְפְּשֶׂ֔הָ וַיַּגְלֶ֖הָ קִ֑ירָה וְאֶת־ רְצִ֖ין הֵמִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ ’ê·lāw me·leḵ ’aš·šūr way·ya·‘al me·leḵ ’aš·šūr ’el- dam·me·śeq way·yiṯ·pə·śe·hā way·yaḡ·le·hā qî·rāh wə·’eṯ- rə·ṣîn hê·mîṯ
verses.literal: So the king of Assyria responded to him marched up . . . . . . to Damascus and captured it He took its people to Kir as captives and put Rezin to death

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָחָ֡ז לִ֠קְרַאת תִּגְלַ֨ת פִּלְאֶ֤סֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁוּר֙ דּוּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וַיַּ֥רְא אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּדַמָּ֑שֶׂק וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֜ז אֶל־ אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֶת־ דְּמ֧וּת הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ וְאֶת־ תַּבְנִית֖וֹ לְכָֽל־ מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz liq·raṯ tiḡ·laṯ pil·’e·ser me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr dūm·me·śeq way·yar ’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’ă·šer bə·ḏam·mā·śeq way·yiš·laḥ ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz ’el- ’ū·rî·yāh hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- də·mūṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·’eṯ- taḇ·nî·ṯōw lə·ḵāl ma·‘ă·śê·hū
verses.literal: Then King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria On seeing the altar in Damascus King Ahaz sent . . . Uriah the priest a model of the altar and complete plans . . . for its construction

verses.original: וַיִּ֛בֶן אוּרִיָּ֥ה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כְּכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַח֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֜ז מִדַּמֶּ֗שֶׂק כֵּ֤ן עָשָׂה֙ אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַד־ בּ֥וֹא הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ אָחָ֖ז מִדַּמָּֽשֶׂק׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen ’ū·rî·yāh hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- šā·laḥ ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz mid·dam·me·śeq kên ‘ā·śāh ’ū·rî·yāh hak·kō·hên ‘aḏ- bō·w ham·me·leḵ- ’ā·ḥāz mid·dam·mā·śeq
verses.literal: And Uriah the priest built the altar according to all the instructions King Ahaz had sent from Damascus and - he completed it before King Ahaz returned

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ מִדַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וַיַּ֥רְא הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּקְרַ֥ב הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וַיַּ֥עַל עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ham·me·leḵ mid·dam·me·śeq way·yar ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ way·yiq·raḇ ham·me·leḵ ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ way·ya·‘al ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: When the king came back from Damascus - and saw the altar he . . . approached it and presented offerings on it

verses.original: וַיַּקְטֵ֤ר אֶת־ עֹֽלָתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־ מִנְחָת֔וֹ וַיַּסֵּ֖ךְ אֶת־ נִסְכּ֑וֹ וַיִּזְרֹ֛ק אֶת־ דַּֽם־ הַשְּׁלָמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ ל֖וֹ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·ṭêr ’eṯ- ‘ō·lā·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- min·ḥā·ṯōw way·yas·sêḵ ’eṯ- nis·kōw way·yiz·rōq ’eṯ- dam- haš·šə·lā·mîm ’ă·šer- lōw ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: He offered his burnt offering and his grain offering poured out his drink offering and splattered the blood of his peace offerings on the altar

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת הַמִּזְבַּ֣ח הַנְּחֹשֶׁת֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ וַיַּקְרֵ֗ב מֵאֵת֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַבַּ֔יִת מִבֵּין֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וּמִבֵּ֖ין בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹת֛וֹ עַל־ יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ צָפֽוֹנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ham·miz·baḥ han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ’ă·šer lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yaq·rêḇ mê·’êṯ pə·nê hab·ba·yiṯ mib·bên ham·miz·bê·aḥ ū·mib·bên bêṯ Yah·weh way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯōw ‘al- ye·reḵ ham·miz·bê·aḥ ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh
verses.literal: He also took . . . the bronze altar that stood before the LORD from the front of the temple between the new altar and the house of the LORD and he put it on the north side of the new altar

verses.original: וַיְצַוֵּהוּ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ אָ֠חָז אֶת־ אוּרִיָּ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן לֵאמֹ֗ר עַ֣ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֣חַ הַגָּד֡וֹל הַקְטֵ֣ר אֶת־ עֹֽלַת־ הַבֹּקֶר֩ וְאֶת־ מִנְחַ֨ת הָעֶ֜רֶב וְֽאֶת־ עֹלַ֧ת הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ וְאֶת־ מִנְחָת֗וֹ וְ֠אֵת עֹלַ֞ת כָּל־ עַ֤ם הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֔ם וְכָל־ דַּ֥ם עֹלָ֛ה וְכָל־ דַּם־ זֶ֖בַח עָלָ֣יו תִּזְרֹ֑ק וּמִזְבַּ֧ח הַנְּחֹ֛שֶׁת יִֽהְיֶה־ לִּ֖י לְבַקֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw·wē·hū ham·me·leḵ- ’ā·ḥāz ’eṯ- ’ū·rî·yāh hak·kō·hên lê·mōr ‘al ham·miz·bê·aḥ hag·gā·ḏō·wl haq·ṭêr ’eṯ- ‘ō·laṯ- hab·bō·qer wə·’eṯ- min·ḥaṯ hā·‘e·reḇ wə·’eṯ- ‘ō·laṯ ham·me·leḵ wə·’eṯ- min·ḥā·ṯōw wə·’êṯ ‘ō·laṯ kāl- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ ū·min·ḥā·ṯām wə·nis·kê·hem wə·ḵāl dam ‘ō·lāh wə·ḵāl dam- ze·ḇaḥ ‘ā·lāw tiz·rōq ū·miz·baḥ han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ yih·yeh- lî lə·ḇaq·qêr
verses.literal: Then King Ahaz commanded Uriah the priest . . . Offer on the great altar the morning burnt offering the evening grain offering and the king’s burnt offering and grain offering as well as the burnt offerings grain offerings and drink offerings of all the people of the land Splatter on the altar all the blood of the burnt offerings and . . . sacrifices But I will use . . . the bronze altar to seek guidance

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֑ן כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖ה הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אָחָֽז׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’ū·rî·yāh hak·kō·hên kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz
verses.literal: So Uriah the priest did just as King Ahaz had commanded

verses.original: וַיְקַצֵּץ֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֜ז אֶת־ הַמִּסְגְּר֣וֹת הַמְּכֹנ֗וֹת וַיָּ֤סַר מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּ֔ר וְאֶת־ הַיָּ֣ם הוֹרִ֔ד מֵעַ֛ל הַבָּקָ֥ר הַנְּחֹ֖שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ל מַרְצֶ֥פֶת אֲבָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·qaṣ·ṣêṣ ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz ’eṯ- ham·mis·gə·rō·wṯ ham·mə·ḵō·nō·wṯ way·yā·sar mê·‘ă·lê·hem wə·ʾɛṯ hak·kî·yōr wə·’eṯ- hay·yām hō·w·riḏ mê·‘al hab·bā·qār han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ’ă·šer taḥ·te·hā way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯōw ‘al mar·ṣe·p̄eṯ ’ă·ḇā·nîm
verses.literal: King Ahaz also cut off the frames of the movable stands and removed the bronze basin from each of them He took down the Sea from the bronze oxen that were under it and put it on a stone base

verses.original: וְאֶת־ מִיסַךְ הַשַּׁבָּ֜ת אֲשֶׁר־ בָּנ֣וּ בַבַּ֗יִת וְאֶת־ מְב֤וֹא הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַֽחִיצ֔וֹנָה הֵסֵ֖ב בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה מִפְּנֵ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- mī·saḵ haš·šab·bāṯ ’ă·šer- bā·nū ḇab·ba·yiṯ wə·’eṯ- mə·ḇō·w ham·me·leḵ ha·ḥî·ṣō·w·nāh hê·sêḇ bêṯ Yah·weh mip·pə·nê me·leḵ ’aš·šūr
verses.literal: And on account of the king of Assyria he removed the Sabbath canopy they had built in the temple and closed the royal entryway outside the house of the LORD

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י אָחָ֖ז אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê ’ā·ḥāz ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hă·lō- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Ahaz along with his accomplishments . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Judah

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב אָחָז֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵ֥ר עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ חִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ ’ā·ḥāz ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·qā·ḇêr ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw bə·‘îr dā·wiḏ way·yim·lōḵ ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ḇə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Ahaz rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David and his son Hezekiah reigned in his place
